encounters.strategyNotes: Avoid striking the armored head; punish body openings.

encounters.notes2: Guaranteed Bloody Slash reward and Kenneth progression.

encounters.notes2: Rewards first Deathroot and Skeletal Militiaman Ashes.

encounters.name: Leonine Misbegotten
encounters.notes: Edgar is available as an optional summon after Irina's Letter is delivered. Rewards 3,800 runes and the Grafted Blade Greatsword; unlocks the Leonine Misbegotten achievement.

encounters.name: Bell Bearing Hunter — Warmaster's Shack
encounters.notes: Spawns after Bernahl's dialogue is exhausted. Has 2,495 HP, rewards 2,700 runes and the Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing.
encounters.notes2: Default route defers unless player is appropriately prepared.
encounters.strategyNotes: Patience, jump discipline, and parry practice are valuable.

encounters.name: Guardian Golem — Highroad Cave
encounters.notes: Has 5,974 HP and rewards 1,700 runes plus the Blue Dancer Charm. Attack the ankles to topple it, then perform a critical attack on the chest core.

encounters.name: Black Knife Assassin — Deathtouched Catacombs
encounters.notes: Begins partially injured and rewards Assassin's Crimson Dagger; Deathroot is in the boss-room chest.

encounters.name: Mounted Godrick Knight — Golden Vow Patrol
encounters.notes: Defeat to obtain Ash of War: Golden Vow.

encounters.name: Recusant Henricus
encounters.notes: Rewards 316 runes and Hammer Talisman; joining Volcano Manor prevents the invasion.

encounters.name: Crucible Knight — Stormhill Evergaol
encounters.notes: Rewards 2,100 runes and Aspects of the Crucible: Tail.

encounters.name: Deathbird — Warmaster's Shack
encounters.location: Southeast of Warmaster's Shack at night
encounters.notes: Rewards 2,800 runes and Blue-Feathered Branchsword.

encounters.name: Margit, the Fell Omen
encounters.notes: Has 4,174 HP; rewards 12,000 runes and Talisman Pouch and unlocks the Margit, the Fell Omen achievement. Sorcerer Rogier is available; Margit's Shackle works only in phase one.
encounters.notes2: Required to open Stormveil progression and grants a Talisman Pouch.
encounters.strategyNotes: Use summons to divide attention; delay attacks punish panic rolls.

encounters.name: Banished Knight — Gostoc's Locked Room
encounters.notes: Gostoc locks the door on first entry. Defeat the knight to safely secure the Curved Sword Talisman and Rusty Key; subsequent entries do not relock after a death.

encounters.name: Crucible Knight — Hidden Rampart
encounters.location: Lower western rampart beneath Rampart Tower
encounters.notes: Activate the lift shortcut before the fight. The knight has 1,391 HP, rewards 1,613 runes, and guarantees Aspects of the Crucible: Horns.

encounters.name: Grafted Scion — Grafting Hall
encounters.location: Grafted Scion hall below the upper treasure rooms
encounters.notes: Has 1,897 HP, rewards 1,176 runes, and does not respawn. Defeat it to fully clear the grafting hall and secure the Highland Axe and adjacent routes.

encounters.name: Ulcerated Tree Spirit — Underground Crypt
encounters.notes: Defeat before Godrick to complete the crypt naturally, obtain its guaranteed Golden Seed, and access Rogier's bloodstain and the Prince of Death's Pustule chamber. No recommended level is assigned because it is not a main progression boss.

encounters.name: Godrick the Grafted
encounters.notes: Has 6,080 HP and rewards 20,000 runes, Godrick's Great Rune, Remembrance of the Grafted, and the Godrick the Grafted achievement. Nepheli Loux is a required route summon; Spirit Ash use remains optional.
encounters.notes2: Canonical Act I shardbearer and Stormveil finale. Nepheli is summoned to preserve her alternate post-boss dialogue.
encounters.flaskDistribution: At least 5 Crimson; remainder build dependent
encounters.consumables: Fireproof Dried Liver optional; bleed/frost or compatible weapon grease
encounters.strategyNotes: Respect delayed axe strings, avoid panic rolls, punish the end of wind and slam sequences, and move behind the opening phase-two fire breath.

encounters.name: Lion Guardian — Tower Bridge Garden
encounters.location: Eastern garden before Limgrave Tower Bridge
encounters.notes: Defeat for Somber Smithing Stone [1], Beast Blood, Old Fang ×2, and approximately 1,138 runes. No recommended level because it is not a main progression boss.

encounters.name: Night's Cavalry — Agheel Lake North
encounters.location: Agheel Lake North bridge at night
encounters.notes: Rewards Ash of War: Repeating Thrust. No recommended level is assigned because it is not a main progression boss.

encounters.name: Mad Pumpkin Head — Waypoint Ruins
encounters.notes: Defeat to access Sorceress Sellen and the Waypoint Ruins Cellar grace. No recommended level is assigned.

encounters.name: Flying Dragon Agheel
encounters.notes: Rewards one Dragon Heart and unlocks Agheel's Flame at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion. No recommended level is assigned.

encounters.name: Runebear — Larval Tear Mimic
encounters.location: Incline east of Agheel Lake South
encounters.notes: A Wandering Noble transforms into a Runebear and guarantees one Larval Tear. No recommended level is assigned.

encounters.name: Mad Tongue Alberich
encounters.location: Lower great hall reached by dropping from the central balcony
encounters.notes: Allow Alberich's Reverential Bow animation to finish before attacking, then defeat him for Taunter's Tongue and Furlcalling Finger Remedy ×1. No recommended level is assigned because this is not a main progression boss.

encounters.name: Erdtree Burial Watchdog — Stormfoot Catacombs
encounters.notes: Rewards Noble Sorcerer Ashes. No numeric benchmark is assigned because it is not a main progression boss.

encounters.name: Bloody Finger Nerijus
encounters.notes: Yura joins after a delay; rewards Reduvia. No numeric benchmark is assigned.

encounters.name: Patches — Murkwater Cave
encounters.notes: Reduce Patches to surrender, stop attacking, and preserve him. No numeric benchmark is assigned.

encounters.name: Grave Warden Duelist — Murkwater Catacombs
encounters.notes: Rewards Banished Knight Engvall Ashes. No numeric benchmark is assigned.

encounters.name: Alabaster Lord — Limgrave Beach
encounters.notes: Guaranteed Ash of War: Gravitas. No numeric benchmark is assigned.

encounters.notes: Summon Blaidd after his Mistwood introduction; rewards Bloodhound's Fang.

knowledge.title: Mining Enemy Defenses
knowledge.guidance: Miners strongly resist many slashing attacks. Use strike damage, two-hand attacks, jump attacks, or magic to avoid weapon bounce.

knowledge.title: Early Smithing-Stone Allocation
knowledge.guidance: Reserve upgrade materials for the currently selected progression weapon rather than spreading limited stones across several experiments.

knowledge.title: Tree Sentinel Timing
knowledge.guidance: Tree Sentinel serves as the intended capstone of West Limgrave after completing the surrounding content.

knowledge.title: Siofra Discovery versus Completion
knowledge.unlockTiming: After activating Siofra River Well Depths grace
knowledge.guidance: Register the underground entrance now, then return to Mistwood. The full Siofra River route is reserved for a later Completion Unit.

knowledge.title: Early Gurranq Access without Dragonbarrow Exploration
knowledge.location: Third Church sending gate / Bestial Sanctum
knowledge.guidance: Use the sending gate to meet Gurranq and claim the first reward package, then return to Limgrave without treating Dragonbarrow as open exploration.

knowledge.title: Weeping Peninsula Arrival and Merchant Closeout
knowledge.location: Bridge of Sacrifice to Castle Morne Rampart
knowledge.guidance: The arrival objective establishes the map and quest state first. The full peninsula sweep begins afterward, with Castle Morne reserved as the regional finale.

knowledge.title: Rogier's Warning Beneath Stormveil
knowledge.location: Hidden exterior ledge above the underground crypt
knowledge.unlockTiming: When Rogier's written message is read
knowledge.guidance: Rogier has already investigated the corruption beneath the castle; continue downward and preserve every trace of his investigation.

knowledge.title: The Corpse Under Stormveil
knowledge.unlockTiming: After collecting Prince of Death's Pustule and witnessing Rogier's bloodstain
knowledge.guidance: Record the discovery without attempting a full explanation yet; the later Lore Companion will connect the corpse, Godwyn, Deathroot, Rogier, Fia, and Ranni.

knowledge.title: Godrick's Great Rune Is Not Yet Active
knowledge.guidance: A Great Rune must be restored at its associated Divine Tower, equipped at a Site of Grace, and activated with a Rune Arc before its blessing applies.

knowledge.title: Preserve and Duplicate Remembrance of the Grafted
knowledge.region: Stormveil Castle / Weeping Peninsula / Roundtable Hold
knowledge.location: Godrick reward and Enia's remembrance menu
knowledge.unlockTiming: After Godrick and before spending the Act I bell-mausoleum duplication
knowledge.guidance: Retain the Remembrance, duplicate it at the Weeping Peninsula bell mausoleum during the Act I completion pass, and claim both Axe of Godrick and Grafted Dragon from Enia.
